title: Smaller size and boot space
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention the car being smaller than previous vehicles, with some appreciation for the compact body but many fragments lacking enough context to show clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the smaller size as appealing while still feeling refined or substantial.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews combine liking the car’s smaller size with an unrelated negative comparison to a Hyundai.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the car, boot, or engine being smaller, but the brief fragments do not make the reviewer’s evaluation clear.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short and do not provide enough context to determine sentiment confidently.
The cluster mixes several size-related subjects, including overall vehicle size, boot space, body dimensions, and engine capacity.
